title: Cómo cobrar de Rippling (2026). Guía sobre métodos de retiro, comisiones y plazos
summary: Cómo cobrar de Rippling: métodos de retiro, comisiones reales, plazos de acreditación y cómo recibir tu pago en Wallbit.
body_text: Conclusiones clave Rippling paga contractors en más de 185 países del mundo. Tu saldo tarda entre 2 y 4 días hábiles en acreditarse. PayPal cobra cerca del 4 % del monto total al retirar. Wallbit te da una cuenta global para cobrar pagos de Rippling. Rippling es otra de las plataformas que usan las empresas para pagar a freelancers y trabajadores remotos que cobran del exterior. La compañía, fundada en 2016 en San Francisco, está valorada en 16.800 millones de dólares tras su ronda Serie G de 2025. Si tu empleador o cliente te paga a través de esta plataforma, la forma en que configures tu retiro define cuánto dinero llega realmente a tu cuenta . En esta guía te contamos cómo funciona Rippling, qué métodos de cobro existen, cuánto cobra cada uno y cómo recibir tu dinero en Wallbit sin perder dinero en comisiones. ¿Qué es Rippling? Rippling es una plataforma de gestión de nómina y fuerza laboral fundada en 2016 en San Francisco por Parker Conrad y Prasanna Sankar. Combina en un solo sistema la gestión de recursos humanos, tecnología y finanzas de una empresa. La compañía paga contractors y empleados en más de 185 países y en más de 50 monedas distintas. Entre sus más de 20.000 clientes hay empresas de todos los tamaños que contratan talento remoto. ¿Cómo funciona Rippling para cobrar? Cuando una empresa te contrata a través de Rippling, tu tiempo trabajado y tus facturas se cargan en la plataforma para su aprobación. Una vez aprobado el pago, el dinero tarda entre 2 y 4 días hábiles en acreditarse en tu saldo , según el banco que financia la nómina. A partir de ahí, tú decides cuándo y cómo retirar tu saldo , sin depender de un calendario fijo de pagos. Rippling se encarga de las conversiones de divisas y los pagos transfronterizos, algo que puede ser lento y costoso si lo hicieras por tu cuenta. Cómo configurar tu método de cobro Antes de recibir tu primer pago, necesitas crear tu perfil de contractor en Rippling y completar el proceso de verificación de identidad (KYC). El proceso está disponible en más de 185 países y suele tomar solo minutos. Una vez firmado tu contrato, entra a la sección de Finanzas y agrega tu método de retiro : cuenta bancaria local, billetera digital o cuenta receptora externa. Ahí también puedes cargar tus facturas por hora o por tarifa fija, que se suman automáticamente a la nómina. Puedes revisar tu saldo y tus próximos pagos, y retirar fondos cuando lo necesites , en lugar de esperar una fecha de pago fija. Qué métodos de retiro ofrece Rippling Rippling ofrece distintas formas de retirar tu saldo, aunque la disponibilidad depende de tu país: Transferencia bancaria (SWIFT) : llega directo a tu cuenta local, pero puede pasar por varios bancos intermediarios que cobran comisión cada uno, además de aplicar un tipo de cambio poco favorable. Billeteras digitales : PayPal, Wise y Payoneer, entre otras. PayPal cobra una comisión de aproximadamente 4 % del monto total. Cuenta bancaria en dólares externa : puedes conectar una cuenta receptora en EE.UU. , como Wallbit, para recibir tu pago sin pasar por bancos intermediarios. Rippling permite pagar en más de 50 monedas locales , con opciones de envío que incluyen transferencias instantáneas en algunos países. Cuánto cobra Rippling por cada retiro Rippling no fija una comisión propia y única para todos los retiros: el costo depende del proveedor detrás de cada método (tu banco, PayPal, Wise o Payoneer), no de una tarifa que cobre la plataforma directamente. Wallbit no cobra comisión por recibir fondos en ningún caso, por ejemplo. Tabla comparativa de comisiones de Rippling Método de retiro Comisión aproximada Tiempo de acreditación Transferencia SWIFT US$15 a US$50 por transacción, según bancos intermediarios 1 a 4 días hábiles PayPal Aproximadamente 4 % del monto total Minutos a horas Wise Sin margen cambiario, tarifa fija por transferencia 1 a 2 días hábiles Payoneer Margen cambiario de hasta 3 % 1 a 2 días hábiles Retiro a Wallbit (ACH/Wire) US$0 de comisión de recepción Hasta 72 horas hábiles Cuánto tarda en acreditarse tu pago Una vez que la empresa aprueba la nómina, el dinero tarda entre 2 y 4 días hábiles en llegar a tu saldo de Rippling, según el banco que procesa el envío. Desde ahí, el tiempo adicional depende del método de retiro que elijas. Los retiros por transferencia SWIFT pueden demorar de 1 a 4 días hábiles, mientras que las billeteras digitales suelen acreditarse en minutos u horas. Rippling no procesa movimientos durante los fines de semana ni los feriados bancarios. ¿Cuál es la mejor app para recibir pagos de Rippling? La mejor alternativa para freelancers y contractors es recibir el pago de Rippling directamente en una cuenta bancaria en Estados Unidos , en lugar de esperar una transferencia SWIFT con bancos intermediarios. En Wallbit te ofrecemos justamente eso: una cuenta global en EE.UU. que puedes cargar como método de retiro dentro de Rippling , desde la sección de Finanzas > Nómina global > Información de pago. Puede recibir dólares estadounidenses, euros y stablecoins. El plan Classic de Wallbit no tiene costo de apertura ni de mantenimiento , y las comisiones de recepción de fondos son de $0 , ya sea por ACH o wire. Si cobras tu sueldo de Rippling con Wallbit, o de plataformas similares como Deel u Ontop , como depósito recurrente, te damos plan Pro gratis , con tarifas preferenciales de retiro e inversión. Desde Wallbit puedes mantener el saldo en dólares , convertirlo a tu moneda local solo cuando lo necesites y gastar con la tarjeta Visa internacional en más de 180 países. También accedes a una cuenta de inversión con protección SIPC Excess de hasta 75 millones de dólares , donde puedes colocar ese dinero en acciones, ETF o bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos en lugar de dejarlo parado sin un plan. El método ideal depende de tus prioridades: velocidad, ahorro o sencillez pueden tener un impacto diferente. Si buscas una cuenta que combine cobro, gasto e inversión en un solo lugar, vincular Wallbit como destino de tus pagos es la opción más completa dentro del ecosistema de Rippling .

title: The business case for reducing patient wait times
summary: Long patient wait times reduce exam room utilization. In some outpatient clinics, exam rooms are used less than half...
body_text: Resource Center The business case for reducing patient wait times Long patient wait times reduce exam room utilization In some outpatient clinics, exam rooms are used less than half of the time the clinic is open, while at the same time, the average wait time in the waiting area is high ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ). Effective room sharing policies increase can achieve a 10-20% increase in patient volume, reduce patient wait times, and improve Exam Room utilization by improving physicians’ access to rooms, reducing idle time, and improving clinical performance by reducing clinic closing time. Long patient wait times reduce patient satisfaction and retention As we’ve mentioned in our earlier blog post , long wait times erode patient satisfaction. As depicted by the table below, patient dissatisfaction negatively influences the likelihood of repeat visits. The effect of wait times on patients' attitudes Jeanne Hill, C & Joonas, Kishwar. (2005). The Impact of Unacceptable Wait Time on Health Care Patients’ Attitudes and Actions. Health marketing quarterly. 23. 69-87. 10.1300/J026v23n02_05. High performing care teams don't take patient churn as a given, they see it as an opportunity. Long wait times increase cancellations Long patient wait times negatively impact patients, providers, and practices. Athenahealth looked at 4.2 million patient appointments across 13,000 provider brackets and found that patient cancellation rates increased as the wait time increased. Long wait times reduce referrals Increased wait times negatively influences the likelihood of recommending the doctor to others. Long wait times reduce rankings According to the 9th Annual Vitals Index, 84 percent of people believe wait time is either “somewhat important” or “very important” to the overall experience at a doctor’s office. In fact, 30 percent of people reported they’ve walked out of an appointment due to long waits. What’s more, 1 in 5 report they’ve changed doctors because of long wait times ( 4 ). Shown below are the results from the 9th Annual Vitals Index showing a strong correlation between individual physician rankings (1-5 Stars) and the amount of time a patient waits (minutes). Correlation between patient wait time and doctor's average ranking Long wait times reduce value based payments Hospital, inpatient, and outpatient settings are increasingly subject to Value-Based Payments (VBP) and other Pay-for-Performance (P4P) contracts that are tied to assessments of quality such as patients’ perceptions of the care provided. High-performance teams looking to increase reimbursement tied to VBP contracts should optimize their performance on measures related to patient experience, patient wait times being one such example ( 5 ). Additionally, VBPs reward providers who promote care delivery in the most efficient settings. Key to value based care is more treatment in ambulatory settings. Reducing wait times can increase outpatient access by 10-20% (link to room room-sharing blog post), bolstering the shift to value-based care. Long wait times can danger multiple revenue sources Physician referrals are crucial for health system profitability. Ensuring that individual physician practices have a good experience, trust in those physicians, we think will help health systems ensure high quality across their network and maintain or grow their downstream physician revenue streams. Maintaining this quality or perceived quality, is vital, as each physician generate $2,378,727 in average annual net revenue ( 6 ).

title: From Ryokans to Riads: The Destinations Known for Distinct Stays
summary: Across the world, some of the most memorable trips are defined not just by where you go, but by where you stay. With 89%* of travelers expressing interest in staying in alternative accommodation types beyond just hotels or resorts, demand is growing for stays that feel more rooted in local culture and place. From centuries-old ryokans in Japan t...
body_text: GettyImages-1463514425 Credit: Booking.com Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download 22 July 2026 | 00:00 AM Europe/Amsterdam From Ryokans to Riads: The Destinations Known for Distinct Stays Across the world, some of the most memorable trips are defined not just by where you go, but by where you stay. With 89%* of travelers expressing interest in staying in alternative accommodation types beyond just hotels or resorts, demand is growing for stays that feel more rooted in local culture and place. From centuries-old ryokans in Japan to carved cave hotels set within the heart of a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Italy and overwater luxury villas in the Maldives, these properties turn a night’s sleep into a cultural experience that is unique in its own right. To help travelers connect more deeply with the destinations they visit, Booking.com has uncovered a collection of stays where the accommodation is just as compelling as the place itself. Ryokan - Hakone , Japan Yaeikan Credit: Booking.com Yaeikan Credit: Booking.com Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download For travelers looking to experience one of Japan’s most iconic accommodation styles, few stays capture the essence of a ryokan, a Japanese inn rooted in centuries-old hospitality, quite like Hakone Onsen Ryokan Yaeikan . Nestled in the mountain town of Hakone, a destination famed for its natural hot springs, this authentic retreat invites guests to slow down and embrace Japanese traditions. Inside, softly lit rooms feature tatami mat flooring, futon bedding and calming interiors that reflect the understated elegance synonymous with ryokan culture. Guests can soak in a selection of indoor and open-air onsen baths, including private hot spring baths that can be reserved for a more intimate experience, all while taking in views of the surrounding mountains. Traditional Japanese breakfasts and multi-course dinners served at the property offer a taste of local flavors, completing the immersive cultural experience. In addition to experiencing traditional Japanese living, in Hakone travelers can cruise across the waters of Lake Ashi, admire views of Mount Fuji on a clear day , visit the striking Hakone Shrine or explore the outdoor sculptures at the Hakone Open-Air Museum. Thanks to the city’s well-connected transport network, it is easy to get around the city without a car by using the Hakone Free Pass, giving visitors access to trains, buses, cable cars, ropeways and sightseeing boats across the city. Cave Hotel - Matera , Italy Il Palazzotto Credit: Booking.com Il Palazzotto Credit: Booking.com Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download Carved into the honey-colored limestone of Matera’s ancient Sassi district, Il Palazzotto Residence & Winery offers travelers the chance to experience one of Italy’s most distinctive accommodation styles: a cave hotel. Set within historic cave dwellings in the heart of this UNESCO World Heritage Site, the property blends centuries-old heritage with contemporary comfort. Rooms and suites feature exposed tuff stone walls, vaulted ceilings and original architectural details, while thoughtful touches ensure a comfortable stay. Adding to its unique charm, the property is home to its own atmospheric wine cellar, where guests can sample regional wines within surroundings carved directly into the rock. Stepping outside, travelers can wander through a maze of ancient cave homes, dating back to 7000 BC and earlier, churches and winding stone alleyways that have earned Matera a reputation as one of Italy’s most captivating destinations. Visitors can admire sweeping views across the dramatic Gravina canyon or opt for a taste of their surroundings in a farm-style pasta cooking class hosted in a traditional underground cellar, learning to prepare Strascinate al tegamino , a beloved local dish passed down through generations. Riad - Essaouira , Morocco Riad Baladin Credit: Booking.com Riad Baladin Credit: Booking.com Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download Hidden within the winding alleyways of Essaouira’s historic medina, a more relaxed experience compared to the infamous Souk Semmarine located a 2-hour drive away in Marrakech, travelers will find Riad Baladin . This intimate riad offers a calm retreat from the buzzing souks outside, blending traditional Moroccan design with the easygoing character of this bohemian port town. The decorated property reflects local craftsmanship through handcrafted details and relaxed, coastal-inspired interiors, while the rooftop terrace becomes a highlight of the stay, offering sweeping views across the medina rooftops toward the ocean and fishing port beyond. From hammam rituals to quiet moments in the courtyard, the experience of staying in this property will allow visitors to easily settle into Essaouira’s distinctive, artistic way of life. Much like this property, Essaouria also offers a laid-back charm to it. While visiting, why not wander through the streets of the UNESCO-listed medina, haggle for the best price on handcrafted woodwork or watch the blue fishing boats return to the city’s bustling harbor. The Atlantic coastline also offers opportunities for surfing , kitesurfing and long walks along the golden sandy beaches. Overwater villa - Baa Atoli , Maldives Dusit Thani Maldives Credit: Booking.com Dusit Thani Maldives Credit: Booking.com Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download For many, staying in an overwater villa is the ultimate bucket-list accommodation experience, and few places embody this dream quite like Dusit Thani Maldives . Set within the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve of Baa Atoll, this island retreat invites guests to wake up suspended above the turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean, where endless sea views stretch from every window and direct access to the lagoon is just a few steps away. The resort’s luxurious overwater villas are designed to blur the boundary between indoor and outdoor living, featuring expansive sun decks, private pools, oversized bathtubs and glass-framed views that place the ocean at the heart of every moment. Guests can step directly from their villa into the crystal-clear waters below to snorkel vibrant coral reefs or simply soak up the Maldivian sunshine, while being waited on by a dedicated butler. A walk down the wood slabbed pathway, guests have access to world-class dining, rejuvenating spa treatments and a range of water-based activities from snorkeling alongside manta rays to exploring colorful house reefs, all within the comfort of this mesmerizing resort. Shepherds Huts - Frome , Somerset Walnut Wagon Credit: Booking.com Walnut Wagon Credit: Booking.com Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download For travelers seeking a slower pace of life, few accommodation styles offer a closer connection to the countryside than a shepherd’s hut. Originally designed as mobile shelters for shepherds tending their flocks, these charming retreats have become one of the United Kingdom’s most beloved rural escapes. Nestled in the picturesque Somerset village of Mells, near Frome, The Walnut Wagon offers guests the opportunity to experience life surrounded by rolling fields and peaceful countryside views. The hut’s compact layout is cleverly used to create a cozy, self-contained stay, with a snug sleeping area, outdoor living space and compact cooking and dining facilities. Guests can enjoy quiet mornings with a coffee overlooking the surrounding landscape or spend evenings stargazing beneath Somerset’s dark skies. A short drive from the hut, Frome is renowned for its independent boutiques, artisan food scene and vibrant cultural events, while the surrounding Somerset countryside is dotted with walking trails, historic villages and country pubs. *Research was commissioned by Booking.com and independently conducted among a sample of adults who had taken a leisure trip in the last 12 months with an overnight stay and plan to travel in 2026. The sample comprised 32,800 respondents across 34 markets surveyed in January 2026.
